title: Partner Sales Manager - IHV Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing IHV alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software‑defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.

Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable IHV teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within an IHV, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with our partners, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements.

Location

This is a remote role.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships and enable partner teams on the partnership
  • Build pipeline and transact opportunities through an IHV
  • Grow partner awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person
  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact
  • Expand existing footprint with IHV customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio
  • Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of IHVs - their products, go‑to‑market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross‑functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with Salesforce and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos diretos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring a proactive, results‑driven approach and a strong commercial mindset. You combine strategic vision with hands‑on engagement, enjoy building lasting relationships with clients and partners, and thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments where you can make a real impact. You approach challenges with a problem‑solving mindset, communicate with clarity and influence, and stay focused and adaptable while managing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, evolving market.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Solid experience in selling safety, automation, or related solutions to EPCs, MEP/contractors, system integrators, or end customers in the energy sector.

  • Proven experience in instrumentation sales within the oil & gas sector, combined with a strong track record in pursuing and winning EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) projects.
  • Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

What We Offer

  • An exciting and challenging position in a team with skilled colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions and flexible working time arrangements.
  • A professional work environment where we always strive to deliver and exceed expectations.

We offer excellent development opportunities, a competitive salary and exceptional benefits including the following.

Our Commitment to You

As an employer of choice, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We aim to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;

description:
PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores:
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro(a) de Implantação de Projetos Pleno que será responsável pela execução e gestão de obras na área de gás, como gasodutos, SCCs, pontos de entrega e recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros. A atuação será voltada ao acompanhamento técnico e operacional das obras, garantindo segurança, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e integridade dos ativos.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar empresas contratadas na implantação das obras
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos, priorizando segurança do trabalho e qualidade técnica
  • Oferecer suporte técnico às equipes contratadas, promovendo alta produtividade
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar documentos técnicos para contratação de serviços (memoriais descritivos, cartas-convite, RFPs, termos de abertura)
  • Definir estratégias de contratação alinhadas às prioridades da NTS e aos requisitos dos projetos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia
  • Experiência em execução e gerenciamento de obras, preferencialmente no setor de gás
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de acompanhamento de cronogramas (MS Project, Excel, Primavera)
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (3 a 4 dias por semana)
  • CNH ativa
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com elaboração de análise de risco
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de transporte por dutos ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência com análise e gerenciamento de riscos
  • Inglês técnico desejável
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

Your profile

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Job description

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma analítica e estratégica na avaliação de risco de crédito, por meio da análise aprofundada de demonstrações financeiras, entendimento da dinâmica operacional e setorial dos clientes, leitura do cenário macroeconômico e das condições de mercado, assegurando decisões de crédito alinhadas à sustentabilidade financeira, rentabilidade e mitigação de riscos da Betunel.

Main responsibilities

Realizar análise econômico-financeira completa dos clientes, com leitura crítica de balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados, fluxo de caixa, endividamento, estrutura de capital, liquidez, rentabilidade e capacidade de geração de caixa;

Avaliar a capacidade de pagamento e de execução operacional dos clientes, considerando histórico de adimplência, carteira de contratos/obras, perfil de recebíveis (especialmente públicos), concentração de risco, garantias e exposição global de crédito;

Analisar o posicionamento do cliente no mercado, seu setor de atuação, nível de competitividade, dependência de contratos públicos ou privados, ciclo do negócio e sensibilidade a variações econômicas;

Monitorar o cenário macroeconômico e setorial (juros, inflação, crédito, investimentos em infraestrutura, orçamento público, funding bancário), avaliando impactos diretos na capacidade financeira dos clientes e no risco da carteira;

Calcular e revisar limites e necessidades de crédito com base na programação de vendas, volumes contratados, preços, exposição já concedida, garantias existentes e perfil de risco;

Propor atualizações na Política de Crédito, considerando mudanças econômicas, regulatórias, práticas de mercado, custos financeiros, execução de garantias e estratégias da concorrência;

Estruturar, aprimorar e operacionalizar modelos de análise de crédito, critérios de rating, segmentação de risco e instrumentos de mitigação;

Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de risco (aging, concentração, exposição, inadimplência, comportamento de pagamento);

Contribuir para a automação das análises, segurança das informações e uso de ferramentas analíticas e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas,
  • Conhecimento da dinâmica de diferentes fontes de recursos (capital próprio, crédito bancário, recebíveis, contratos públicos).
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanços, DRE, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros;
  • Conhecimento em finanças corporativas e matemática financeira;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de análise de crédito e gestão de risco;
  • Análise de mercado, tendências macro e microeconômicas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e construção de dashboards analíticos;
  • Noções de legislação relacionada a crédito, garantias e execução.
  • Experiência em análise de crédito, preferencialmente em setores de infraestrutura, construção, indústria ou serviços B2B;
  • Vivência em análise de demonstrações financeiras, avaliação de risco, leitura de mercado e acompanhamento de clientes;
  • Experiência com análise de concorrência, ambiente econômico e movimentações setoriais;

description:
InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO₂ while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care of Accounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You'll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically – structured, purpose‑driven, and comfortable switching between hands‑on tasks and higher‑level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month‑end and year‑end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash‑flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3‑5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards, IFRS, and multi‑entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR), and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Key Qualities

  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard‑working and hands‑on
  • Detail‑oriented and analytical, with a problem‑solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross‑border or fast‑growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. title: Senior Regulatory Analyst
description:
Overview

The Senior Regulatory Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This position will coordinate regulatory requirements, consolidate technical documentation, assess compliance risks, support audits and inspections, and implement action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non‑compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities’ requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets.
  • Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets.
  • Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules.
  • Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions.
  • Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate.
  • Assess the content of engineering, tech safety, and other management system documents to provide proper support and guidance to achieve compliance.
  • Follow up on specific discussions and execution wherever assigned to ensure proper incorporation of regulatory compliance requirements and related risk.
  • Support activities to implement BWE strategy and scope for internal regulatory compliance self-assessment, inspections, and audits to prevent project schedule delays, interdictions and fines.
  • Track, manage, and ensure proper closure and documentation of regulatory-related action items.
  • Perform and/or guide inspections and audits of BWE facilities to assess and ensure proper compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements.
  • Organize and coordinate internal preparations for regulatory audits.
  • Flag to the Regulatory and Institutional Affairs Manager always when a potential critical non-conformance is identified or delays in regulatory compliance may delay schedules or not follow the original budgets.
  • Support all other regulatory-related activities when required.

Education

  • Engineering degree.

Experience

  • Experience with regulatory requirements applied to offshore platforms.
  • Experience fulfilling requirements for ANP shipyard audits.
  • Experience responding to ANP conditions to operate.
  • Knowledge of Class, Flag, and Navy requirements.

Knowledge

  • Good understanding and knowledge of Offshore systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc
  • Advanced English.

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

description:
Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Rio de Janeiro)

Rio de Janeiro

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;
  • Certificação CPA-20.

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos

  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Sr. Energy Storage Project Development Team Leader

Locations: FULLY REMOTE - Brazil (Rio de Janeiro, Sau Paulo, and surrounding areas)

This is an opportunity to join a trailblazing BESS (Battery Energy Storage) company backed by top-tier private equity, leading the charge in utility-scale energy storage development, execution, and operations. With a rapidly expanding national footprint, and double digit GW portfolio including one of the largest fleets of grid-connected, standalone battery storage assets in the country.

These assets strengthen the grid by storing excess energy and delivering it during peak demand, storms, or outages. Fast and flexible, they provide critical grid services acting like modern power plants to support a more reliable, resilient energy system.

The Sr. Renewables BESS Development Manager will de-risk and take next generation battery storage projects through the full development lifecycle in Brazil. These are complex portfolios that require an intimate knowledge of the transmission interconnection and permitting as it relates to the project development process. A proven showcased by a proven track record of working through transmission auctions, ONS and EPE rules to get projects to NTP/COD in Brazil. This role will help lead and drive the commercial strategy in Brazil and represent the company's interest through manager relationships with Brazilian Partners.

They are committed to creating more renewable infrastructure solutions for the grid and are offering comprehensive compensation packages to their employees leading the drive to meet company goals. Other perks included a competitive base salary, open PTO policy, flex work hours, health benefits, the opportunity to work with a transparent Executive Leadership Team..and more.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Lead greenfield utility-scale grid infrastructure development projects through the creation of development and project de-risking strategies
  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Responsible for bringing greenfield development assets from site origination, permitting, interconnection, and revenue contract, through project NTP
  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Acts as the frontline commercial negotiator for PPAs, interconnection, ONS, EPE, and other related agreements/policies
  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Acquires project sites for utility-scale grid infrastructure projects then brings them through the diligence and de-risking process
  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Works with markets and origination team to identify and quantify opportunities, then owning responsibility for RFP submittal for utility-scale solar renewable projects
  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Ensures all projects/deals continue to meet or exceed financial hurdles and manages the financing of each new grid infrastructure development deal

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Commercial Management and Project Management Leadership experience that involves working through EPE, ONS, Power market structures, or transmission auctions in Brazil
  • Proven track record of developing tactical renewable energy, transmission, or energy infrastructure project development tactics and portfolio de-risking strategies in Brazil
  • Experience taking multiple grid-connected utility-scale renewable energy projects from greenfield site origination through to NTP/COD in Brazil
  • Experience working through the following agreement types: Site lease or purchase agreements, Site Plan and Building Permit approvals, Interconnection agreements, Power purchase or tolling agreements, and MIPA / PSA for project disposition / acquisition
  • Well versed in project siting, permitting, prospecting, and other due diligence initiatives for utility-scale renewables
  • MUST have a breadth of hands-on experience with real estate/land transactions & contracts for projects with Developers / IPPs
  • Solid understanding of the RFP / RFI process as it relates to renewable project development initiatives
  • Any exposure or renewable energy project experience with energy storage, battery storage, or solar + storage is a HUGE PLUS
  • Previous utility-scale renewable energy development experience working in the following roles: Sr. Project Development Manager, Senior Manager of Project Development, Sr. Project Manager (Development), Business Development Manager, M&A Project Development Leader, Sr. Renewables Developer, Commercial Portfolio Manager, Lead Project Developer...etc

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Analista N2 Pleno

Empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade:
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP:
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conce sabe TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana).
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG.
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim, sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.
  • Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo.
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa.

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management.
    FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 01 March (tentative or to be agreed)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates’s football.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

Somos a Base Exchange, a futura nova Bolsa de Valores do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos tornar o mercado de capitais mais dinâmico, acessível e conectado, criando oportunidades que impulsionam a mudança e fortalecem a economia.

No seu dia a dia você irá

  • Criar indicadores e alertas de supervisão de mercado de bolsa;
  • Parametrizar e utilizar sistemas de geração de alertas de fraudes em operações com valores mobiliários;
  • Realizar análises e investigações de operações atípicas;
  • Elaborar relatórios para reguladores;
  • Enviar ofícios para participantes no âmbito de investigações de operações atípicas.

O que você precisa:

  • Experiência na configuração de sistemas de supervisão de mercado, criação de indicadores e alertas automáticos para detecção de práticas irregulares e análise de padrões atípicos de negociação;
  • Vivência na investigação de operações atípicas, envolvendo indícios de manipulação de preços, criação de condições artificiais, insider trading, wash trades, spoofing, layering e money pass, com base em dados de mercado e registros de negociação;

  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
